en.headline: Italy-Hong Kong menswear show opens today at Fashion Walk
en.dek: Future Threads gathers ten emerging designers from Hong Kong and Italy at a free Causeway Bay exhibition running through 13 September.
body: A free menswear exhibition jointly organised by the Hong Kong Design Centre and Italy's Camera Nazionale della Moda Italiana opens today at Fashion Walk in Causeway Bay and runs until 13 September.

Titled Future Threads: Menswear's New Waves Between Italy and Hong Kong, the show is a programme of the government-presented Hong Kong Fashion Fest and is sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency. It is curated by Sara Sozzani Maino, the Italian chamber's international talent and brand ambassador. Under Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Raistlin Lau attended the opening ceremony on Wednesday.

Ten emerging labels are taking part, five from each city, with a preview of Spring/Summer 2027 collections. The Hong Kong names listed by the organisers include AENRMOUS, Murfi Lau, Ponder.er, The World Is Your Oyster and Wilsonkaki. The Italian names include Domenico Orefice, Grossi, Materia, MTL Studio and Victor-Hart.
The organisers said the exhibition is at Shop 3, G/F and 1/F, 2-4 Kingston Street, Fashion Walk. Hours are 11am to 8pm. Admission is free. Causeway Bay MTR Exit D2 is the nearest station.

zh.headline: 意港男裝展今起銅鑼灣Fashion Walk免費開放
zh.dek: 香港設計中心聯同意大利國家時裝商會舉辦的「共織新意」今日至9月13日在銅鑼灣展出十個新銳男裝品牌。
body: 由香港設計中心主辦、並與意大利國家時裝商會合作的男裝展覽「共織新意：意大利與香港男裝新浪潮」，今日起至9月13日在銅鑼灣Fashion Walk舉行，免費入場。
展覽屬特區政府主辦的香港時裝薄節目，由文創產業發展處贊助，由意大利國家時裝商會國際新銳人才及品牌大使Sara Sozzani Maino策展。文化體育及旅遊局副局長劉震周三出席開幕禮。
展覽匯聚十個分別來自香港及意大利的新銳男裝品牌，預覽2027春夏系列。主辦單位列出的香港品牌包括AENRMOUS、Murfi Lau、Ponder.er、The World Is Your Oyster及Wilsonkaki；意大利品牌包括Domenico Orefice、Grossi、Materia、MTL Studio及Victor-Hart。
主辦單位表示，場地為銅鑼灣Fashion Walk京士頓街2至4號地下及一樓3號舖，開放時間上午11時至晚上8時，免費入場，鄰近港鐵銅鑼灣站D2出口。
